question: Which restaurant/restaurants violated health/food codes most?
output_text:

1. Most Total Violations: Stella Grill (4291 S 900 E, Millcreek) recorded the highest total number of violations with 123 total citations (38 critical, 85 non-critical) across its inspection history, including a permit suspension in July 2023 for lack of cold holding capacity.
2. Most Critical Violations: Sagato Bakery & Cafe (44 W 7200 S, Midvale) logged the highest count of critical health violations with 47 critical citations (88 total violations). Its violations repeatedly involve temperature control (cold holding and hot holding), handwashing practices, demonstration of knowledge, and food separation.
3. Other High-Violation Restaurants:
   - Texas Roadhouse (1904 W 5400 S, Taylorsville): 113 total violations (38 critical)
   - Burger King (10396 S River Heights Dr, South Jordan): 104 total violations (28 critical)
   - Baskin-Robbins (1465 E 2100 S, Salt Lake City): 98 total violations (25 critical)

   - Arctic Circle (3365 W 7800 S, West Jordan): 95 total violations (27 critical)
   - Siegfried's Delicatessen (20 W 200 S, Salt Lake City): 64 total violations (34 critical)
   - Navajo Hogan (447 E 3300 S, South Salt Lake): 83 total violations (33 critical)

Note on Data Availability: Only 139 of 8,592 establishments (1.6%) in the dataset have matched SLCHD inspection histories; these figures reflect the highest counts among matched establishments.

SELECT e.name, e.address, s.total_violation_count, s.critical_violation_count
FROM establishments e
JOIN slchd_listings s ON e.slchd_establishment_key = s.slchd_establishment_key
ORDER BY s.total_violation_count DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  e.name,
  e.address,
  COUNT(v.violation_id) AS total_violations,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) AS critical_violations
FROM establishments e
JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.address
ORDER BY total_violations DESC
LIMIT 10

  e.name || ' (' || e.address || ')' AS restaurant,
  COUNT(v.violation_id) AS total_violations
FROM establishments e

JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.address
ORDER BY total_violations DESC
LIMIT 10

  COUNT(v.violation_id) AS critical_violations
FROM establishments e

args.query:
SELECT 
  e.name,
  e.address,
  COUNT(v.violation_id) AS total_violations,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) AS critical_violations
FROM establishments e
JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.address
ORDER BY total_violations DESC
LIMIT 10
